reasons: Reference files contain one node sequence per trajectory, not a label per GPS point.
Sparse observations (311 points) do not align 1:1 with dense/reference vertices.
Randomly splitting points from the same trip would leak trajectory identity.
Identifiers match vertexMap node IDs; they are a path, not candidate-class labels.
if_labels_become_available: Split by trajectory order_index, never by shuffling adjacent points.
Keep reference path out of feature columns.
Report candidate-ranking metrics separately from HMM sequence metrics.

metric_definitions.mean_match_distance: Euclidean GPS-to-matched-road distance in native projected units (not metres unless 1 unit happens to be 1 m).
metric_definitions.edge_precision_recall: Set overlap between predicted observation edges and reference path edges. Not a point-accuracy score.
